findings.observation: The chibi retains Aeon’s mature light-medium skin, round full face, full cheeks, sharply defined brows, crooked healed nose, balanced closed mouth, faint freckles, and steady adult identity rather than substituting a generic doll face.
Her short soft-round construction, evident middle, gentle limb contours, shoulder and torso width, leg mass, and evenly planted posture remain consistent with the summon under chibi compression.
The source’s soft substantial upper arms and forearms are preserved without disproportionate inflation; wrists and both empty hands remain articulated and proportional.
The brown-chestnut shaved-close-cropped silhouette and swept short top remain recognizable, but the shaved side shows multiple parallel razor lines rather than exactly one offset razor line.

The oxblood-navy quilted outerwear, fitted underlayer, tapered trousers, offset closures, reinforced cuffs, rhythmic red edge repeats, singular dangling earring, and shaped chest clasp remain source-bound. However, the source-visible polished seed case is absent rather than visibly stowed while both hands remain empty.
Original-resolution visual measurement places topmost hair near y=155, chin near y=577, and lower sole near y=1395: about 422/1240, or 34.0%, clearly inside the frozen 32–36% range.
Exactly one adult figure appears with the complete close-cropped head, both empty hands, jacket, both legs, and both complete shoes inside generous parchment margins.
The three-quarter turn, broad planted feet, compact short silhouette, and two readable empty hands form a clear grounded weaponless ready-idle at combat-icon scale.

The quilted cloth, ordinary clasp, and non-glowing earring retain a mortal one-star presentation with no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, elemental effect, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, or watermark.
